name.zh-CN: 家庭服务器与 Docker 体检医生

tagline.zh-CN: 排查 NAS、Docker Compose、反向代理与磁盘空间告警，只做可回滚的安全建议。
tagline.en: Diagnoses NAS, Docker Compose, reverse-proxy, and disk alerts with safe, reversible steps.

description.zh-CN: 面向自部署与 Homelab 玩家的日常运维医生：分析容器日志、OOM、健康检查失败、证书过期与磁盘膨胀，提供只读诊断命令和可回滚修复清单。
description.en: A pragmatic operations companion for self-hosters and homelab owners. Triages container crash loops, OOM kills, reverse-proxy errors, TLS expiry, and disk bloat with read-only checks and reversible runbooks.
